reviews.title: Great product!
reviews.comment: Works great no issues, put it in to replace my smaller GeForce card booted right up updated the drivers and plays my game so smooth.

reviews.title: reman reliable.
reviews.comment: was skeptical on running a remanufactured card. I ran it for a few days and everything ran great. temps were low, clocks were accurate. 3060 TI is the minimum standard of a card I would run in a gaming pc rig in 2023.
reviews.author: Johnathon Valdivia
